newsitem.title: NORWAY: Nera shelves new share issue.
newsitem.headline: Nera shelves new share issue.

text.p: Norwegian telecommunications company Nera ASA said on Friday it had cancelled a planned share offering of 2.5 million shares.

The company said it had cancelled the issue due to recent developments in its share price on the Oslo bourse. Nera's share price suffered a sharp decline last month after the group issued a profit warning for the first quarter.
"Based on the recent rate developments for Nera shares, it has been decided not to implement the planned share offering," a company statement said.
Nera stock closed at 45.50 crowns on Wednesday compared with a year high on April 15 of 73.60 crowns.
The company said it had been accepted for listing on the Singapore stock exchange. The initial listing is expected to take place at the beginning of May.
